title: RIFT VOLUME
description: A spatial sculpture built from three drifting SDF masses and a connected folded membrane. Touch deposits a persistent pressure scar into a hidden material field, eroding the raymarched volume and imparting force to nearby masses instead of drawing a cursor effect.

visual_finish.composition: three offset toroidal masses linked by a thin folded membrane with a deep central negative volume
visual_finish.material_model: dark mineral ceramic with spectral grazing highlights, carved pressure scars and micro surface relief
